entities.name: EMM-TRACKING-AREA-UPDATING-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by a UE after starting the tracking area updating or combined tracking area updating procedure while waiting for a response from the MME.

entities.name: Tracking Area Updating Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE for tracking area updating or combined tracking area updating.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that initiates the tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: MME
entities.description: Mobility Management Entity that provides response to the tracking area updating procedure.

relations.description: Starting the tracking area updating procedure causes the UE to enter the EMM-TRACKING-AREA-UPDATING-INITIATED state.
UE initiates the tracking area updating procedure.
UE remains in EMM-TRACKING-AREA-UPDATING-INITIATED state while waiting for response from MME.
